This page summarizes customer-visible fixes and known issues for MR 32.2.5. It is intended for network administrators evaluating an upgrade or troubleshooting behavior after deployment. The inventory is based on the exact MR 32.2.5 release issue set, and affected models and versions are limited to the available confirmed engineering evidence.
MR Access Point Fixed Issue Details
MR Access Point Known Issue Details
Security fixes: As part of Cisco's ongoing commitment to proactive security and product quality, the MR engineering team has conducted a comprehensive internal security review. This review resulted in one or more software hardening releases that address multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities.

Security fixes

As part of Cisco's ongoing commitment to proactive security and product quality, the MR engineering team has conducted a comprehensive internal security review. This review resulted in one or more software hardening releases that address multiple internally discovered vulnerabilities.
